verdict.rationale: Phoenix's own docs describe LLM-as-a-judge evaluators in which a second model scores output against a rubric. These evaluators can be configured in the UI and attached to datasets, and SDKs give full control over evaluation logic and judge models. Judge models are swappable through adapters, and explanations plus judge prompts are captured. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specific to configuring LLM-judge evaluators (the community item only mentions using evals generally).

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators
